module.name: AWS Security & IAM
module.description: Creates IAM roles, security groups, and SSH key pair for EKS cluster and infrastructure access. Includes optional jumphost deployment.

required.reason: Requires VPC for security group and jumphost placement

required.name: vpc_id
required.description: ID of the VPC for security group creation

required.name: vpc_cidr_block
required.description: CIDR block of the VPC for security group ingress rules

required.name: public_subnet_id
required.description: Public subnet ID for jumphost deployment

required.name: user_ip
required.description: Your public IP address for SSH access to jumphost (CIDR format)

optional.name: enable_oidc_provider
optional.description: Create IAM OIDC provider for EKS service accounts

optional.name: deploy_jumphost
optional.description: Deploy EC2 jumphost for cluster access

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Name of the EKS cluster (for automated OIDC provider setup)

optional.name: create_oidc_provider
optional.description: Create OIDC provider for service account roles (requires EKS cluster)

optional.name: eks_oidc_issuer_url
optional.description: EKS cluster OIDC issuer URL (required if create_oidc_provider is true)

optional.name: enable_detailed_monitoring
optional.description: Enable detailed CloudWatch monitoring for jumphost

optional.name: enable_enhanced_node_permissions
optional.description: Enable enhanced permissions for node groups (ENI management, SSM)

optional.name: enable_f5_bnk_roles
optional.description: Enable F5 BIG-IP Next service account roles (for future F5 module)

optional.name: enable_jumphost_backup
optional.description: Enable backup jumphost instance (for production environments)

optional.name: kubectl_release_date
optional.description: Release date for kubectl version (AWS EKS format: YYYY-MM-DD)

optional.name: kubectl_version
optional.description: Version of kubectl to install (should match EKS version)

optional.name: ssh_key_rsa_bits
optional.description: Number of bits for RSA SSH key (ignored for other algorithms)

key_outputs.name: infrastructure_key_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the SSH key pair for infrastructure access

key_outputs.name: vpc_security_group_id
key_outputs.description: ID of the VPC security group for EKS cluster

key_outputs.name: eks_cluster_role_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the IAM role for EKS cluster

key_outputs.name: nodegroup_role_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the IAM role for EKS node groups

key_outputs.name: nodegroup_role_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the EKS node group IAM role

key_outputs.name: jumphost_public_ip
key_outputs.description: Public IP address of the jumphost (if deployed)

key_outputs.name: oidc_provider_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the IAM OIDC provider for EKS (if enabled)
